payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model compared to baseline models, quantifying the enhancements in F1-scores for various discourse relations.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The model achieved a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, outperforming previous neural tensor network models by more than 2%.
The ensemble model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit discourse relations.
